# SEC EDGAR fixtures

Hand-built in the documented response shapes of `company_tickers_exchange.json`,
`submissions/CIK##########.json` and `api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK##########.json`. The registrant
(CIK 0000000042, "Test Registrant Inc.", ticker TEST_EDGR) and every value are made up.

They are **not recordings**: recording live responses needs the project's real User-Agent contact
(SEC fair-access policy). Re-record trimmed live responses on the first live run and keep these
files' structure. Tracked in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
